Package org.openpdf.text.pdf

Class PdfDocument

java.lang.Object
org.openpdf.text.Document
org.openpdf.text.pdf.PdfDocument
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, EventListener, DocListener, ElementListener
public class PdfDocument extends Document
PdfDocument is the class that is used by PdfWriter to translate a Document into a PDF with different pages.

This pruned version only manages pages (that are filled by the content of the writer), the information dictionary, the catalog and the annotations of the pages. The layout of text, tables and images is not supported.
